allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Sasken Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the approval of the Share Allotment Committee of the Company was sought by way of a circular resolution circulated on August 03, 2026. The majority assent was received on August 3, 2026 and final assent thereto was received on August 04, 2026 at 9:40 a.m.
